overview.Name: K.O. Coliseum
overview.Theme: Anime fighting tournament (Battle Academia, Soul Fighter, Mighty Mech, Star Guardian, Supreme Cells, Luchador, The Crew).

mechanics: Power Ups: twice per game (rounds 1-3 and 3-6) the player receives a Power Snax item. Using it on a champion opens a choice of three Power Ups for that champion. A Power Up is a champion-attached ability modifier; it can later be removed and moved to another unit, or replaced with a new one. In the data, Power Ups are stored as traits with the "MechanicTrait" prefix; they are listed in their own section below.
Portals are gone from the data (no portal list for Set 15). Opening encounters remain.

Crystal Gambit earns Gem Power from kills and losses and offers a cash-out or Double Down every 3 player combats; Mentor is active only with exactly 1 or 4 unique Mentors; Rogue Captain (Twisted Fate) draws Bounty Cards each round; Stance Master lets Lee Sin pick a stance (Duelist, Executioner, Juggernaut) with its own ability and trait; Monster Trainer lets Lulu choose which monster replaces her in combat. See traits.
